evals.name: fresh-doc-python-backend
evals.prompt: Can you document the structure of the inventory-api project? It's at <REPO>. I want a PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md in the repo root that a new dev joining my team could actually use to find their way around.
evals.expected_output: PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md at repo root with annotated tree, module breakdown, Mermaid system overview + class diagram showing model/service fields, key flows, and a meta block recording the basis.

evals.name: update-git-history
evals.prompt: A bunch of work got merged into ticketdesk (<REPO>) since the structure doc was written. Bring PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md up to date with what's actually in the code now, and I want to be able to see what changed between the two versions.
evals.expected_output: Old doc archived (not deleted), doc rewritten to cover notifications/gateways/jobs/teams, hand-written <!-- keep --> note preserved verbatim, dated changelog listing added/removed/renamed items including the auth.ts -> authenticate.ts rename, diagrams regenerated, meta block updated to new HEAD.

evals.name: update-separate-drop
evals.prompt: I got a new version of ticketdesk as a separate folder: <NEW>. The old version, which has the structure file in it, is at <OLD>. There's no shared git history between them. Read the new files, compare them against the structure file we already have, and give me an updated structure doc for the new version. Don't delete the old structure file.
evals.expected_output: Updated doc describing v2.3.0, old doc preserved, comparison performed against the previous survey snapshot or the old doc's tree, changelog naming added/removed/renamed files, keep-marked note carried forward.
